methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Cabinet secretary: Southside county loses two economic development prospects due to uncertainty over data center taxes
signals.signal_reading: Tax policy uncertainty blocks data center investment in Greensville County, demonstrating how historically underserved regions remain vulnerable to policy volatility that concentrates AI infrastructure opportunity in established metros with stable incentive frameworks.

signals.title: EPA grant backs community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: EPA-funded community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia signals distributed capability-building through local institutions, potentially enabling peer-to-peer skill networks outside traditional tech hubs if training depth moves beyond surface-level platform use.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU-AI Ready RVA partnership creates institutional anchor for deep AI education and innovation in Richmond, but concentration around university-led initiatives risks reinforcing metro-hub advantages unless explicit distribution mechanisms reach beyond immediate urban ecosystem.

signals.title: Norfolk Southern deploys AI system to catch wheel defects before they break - The Business Journals
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk Southern's turnkey AI deployment for wheel defect detection represents shallow-but-functional adoption through vendor solutions in industrial sectors—broad operational benefit without building internal AI expertise or regional capability depth.

signals.title: Kennedy: NextEra-Dominion’s AI future could reshape Virginia’s economy — and its energy politics
signals.signal_reading: NextEra-Dominion deal positions AI energy infrastructure demands as statewide economic reshaping force, but energy-AI nexus concentrates planning authority and benefit capture in Northern Virginia data center corridors while distributing costs and environmental impact to rural energy production regions.
